digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend seam and Jira-family adapter layer
propositions: ADR 0035 section 6 falsely states the first real second backend is out of scope, but Jira Data Center landed ahead of the reserved GitHub adapter (epic be74), appearing in at least three places in the ADR that must be corrected

the TicketTransport protocol declares six members but the core reconciler accesses twenty-one distinct transport members, with twelve absent from the DC adapter causing silent sync failures and at least one live crash while all contract and unit tests pass green

RemoteRef.instance is presented as an existing deployment-distinction mechanism but is never constructed in production code (only in test helpers), contradicting the shared-jira provenance design decision
the backend contract suite certification claim from ADR 0035 is conditional on port completeness and typed parameters, a condition invisible without structural tests and enforcement via mypy
the DC adapter's live smoke tests must exercise the documented user-guide configuration and commands against a real ephemeral DC instance to prevent silent documentation rot
